description: Interactive step-based rhythm counter for Grade 7 Mathematics — Chapter 6: Number Play, Virahanka-Fibonacci sequence. Redesigned with Singularity Design System: Poppins font, indigo (#4A4DC9) + orange (#FF7212) palette, purple-to-orange gradients (#533086 → #FC9145), lavender (#C1C1EA) and cream (#FFF3E4) light fills, pill-shaped buttons (border-radius: 100px). Displays rhythm patterns as coloured blocks: short syllable (1 beat) as indigo square, long syllable (2 beats) as gradient purple-to-orange rectangle. Six progressive steps from n=1 to n=5 plus recursive rule reveal.

buttonStyles.outlined: Border only, pill shape, hover fills soft background

showTablaLabels.description: Show 'ta'/'dha' labels (Indian tabla). When false, shows '1'/'2'.

instructionsForStudent: Watch as rhythm patterns are built for increasing beat counts using short (1-beat) and long (2-beat) blocks. Count along and notice the pattern: each count is the sum of the previous two. This is how the Virahanka-Fibonacci sequence is born!
